_meta.description: Hard-remove a person from YeshID's tracking system via the People list row action ('Remove person'). Distinct from 02-user-delete (which runs the Offboarding *workflow* — soft-deactivates a person, sets YeshID status to 'Deactivated', but leaves the row in the People list). 'Remove person' actually deletes the row and drops the total people count by 1. Live-verified 2026-07-11 removing 7 e2e test records in one session (bookend count 44 -> 37, exactly -7).

user_email.description: Primary email of the person to remove. Used to uniquely match the row — do NOT match by name alone, several test records share a display name (e.g. two 'Test User' rows with different emails) with only the email column disambiguating them.
user_email.hint: Must be the exact primary email shown in the People table's 'Primary email' column.

_meta.warning: DESTRUCTIVE and NOT reversible via YeshID UI (per the confirm-dialog copy: 'Removing a person will take them out of YeshID's tracking system... the person's identity or account will still exist outside of YeshID.' — it deletes YeshID's tracking record, not the underlying Google/directory identity). Verify user_email carefully before running; do not run against a live/production person by guessing an email pattern.

verificationStrategy.pre: h0c counts people-table rows on /organization/people via paginationTotal()
verificationStrategy.post: hZc counts people-table rows on /organization/people via paginationTotal()
verificationStrategy.primaryVerification: success snackbar text matches '<Name> has been removed' AND the row for user_email no longer appears in the table AND final count == initial count - 1
verificationStrategy.note: The row-action kebab menu (rightmost column, unlabeled '...' button per row) exposes THREE options: 'View person', 'Run workflow', 'Remove person' (red), 'Deactivate person' (orange). 'Remove person' is the hard-delete this recipe drives. Confirm dialog title reads 'Remove <Full Name>' — use it as a final identity check before clicking the red 'Remove' confirm button, since the kebab menu itself carries no name/email context once open.

search-input.description: Search input on people list page

row-kebab-button.resolveHint: Unlabeled icon button (three vertical dots) in the rightmost column of the row matching user_email. Live-verified via `row.querySelector('button')` where row is the <tr> whose textContent includes user_email — that <tr> has exactly one <button>, the kebab. No stable class/data-cy found as of 2026-07-11; resolved by DOM structure (only button in the matched row), not by selector string.

remove-person-menuitem.resolveHint: Row-action dropdown (opened by row-kebab-button) has 4 items: 'View person', 'Run workflow' (opens submenu, not needed here), 'Remove person' (red text, hard delete), 'Deactivate person' (orange text, soft — NOT what this recipe wants). Match by exact textContent 'Remove person'.

remove-confirm-button.resolveHint: Confirm dialog titled 'Remove <Full Name>' has two buttons: 'Go back' and 'Remove' (red/error variant). Match by exact textContent 'Remove' scoped to the active dialog/overlay — do not match the row-kebab 'Remove person' menuitem text again.

chain.note: Bookend count before removal, read from the Vuetify data-table footer.
Sanity check the target row exists and its display name, before mutating anything. Abort (branch) if empty.

Open the row action menu for the row matching user_email. NOTE: as of 2026-07-11 the engine's target-resolver could not reliably click this via CSS selector alone in ad-hoc testing — a structural row-scan (find <tr> containing user_email text, click its lone <button>) was used instead via direct DOM script. If click-by-target fails here, fall back to a `js` step: `document.querySelector('table tbody tr:has-text("' + user_email + '")').querySelector('button').click()` equivalent.
NOT 'Deactivate person' — that's the soft/reversible option. NOT 'Run workflow' — that's the Offboarding workflow (see 02-user-delete).
VERIFY identity before confirming: dialog title should read 'Remove <Full Name>' matching the person for user_email.
HOME END: re-navigate to re-read the footer count cleanly.
